commands.name: split
commands.description: Split a .pptx file into individual single-slide files.

options.name: --output
options.description: Output directory for the individual slide files (default: same directory as input, or the current directory when reading from stdin).

options.name: --slides
options.description: Slides to extract. Syntax: comma-separated list of 1-based slide numbers and/or inclusive ranges, e.g. '1,3,6-9'. Whitespace allowed around separators. Duplicates are deduplicated. Default: all slides.

options.name: --force
options.description: Overwrite existing output files. Without this flag the command fails on the first collision.

options.name: --manifest
options.description: Also write a deck manifest (clippit pptx build run compatible) alongside the slides. Path: <outputDir>/<sourceBaseName>.manifest.json (or stdin.manifest.json for stdin input). Preserves source PPTX sections when present.
